description: Overlapping flat-ended bars and chevron glyphs, semi-transparent and layered over one another, assembled into a small totemic figure that floats in a large black field — closest to a lashed effigy or a bundle of splints bound around a vertical spine. The palette is strictly four values: bone white, mid grey, near-black charcoal and a dusty olive-moss green, on a near-black ground; there is no accent hue, no gradient, no texture beyond the stroke overlap itself. All twelve share the same stroke vocabulary — straight quadrilateral bars with squared ends, plus a recurring zigzag/chevron motif — but they differ enormously in scale and organisation: 9906 is a full-frame bone-white starburst, 10980 a fine radiating spoke burst, 10085 a stack of horizontal green striations, 10622 a swept C-arc, 10801 a column of chunky chevrons, 10443 a sparse crossing scribble, while 9548 is a thumbnail-sized column and 9727 is only four thin unfilled zigzags; one of the twelve, 9190, renders nothing at all — the cell is empty at both sizes and in all three market conditions. The frame is used loosely: nearly everything is centred with a wide black margin, little bleeds to an edge, and the smaller tokens occupy well under a tenth of the canvas. Across the three conditions the figure keeps its skeleton but changes weight — neutral is the base density, stress strips strokes away and drains the light values toward grey (9548 collapses to two bars and a fragment), and recovery adds the most strokes and returns the brightest whites.
seenAt120: The strong tokens still read as distinct silhouettes — the starburst, the horizontal striation stack, the C-arc and the chevron column are each individually identifiable, and the vertical-spine figures hold their shape. What is lost is the chevron detail, which becomes generic texture, and the value separation inside a token; the palette collapses to roughly 'pale scribble' versus 'green scribble'. Three of the twelve cells are effectively empty at browse size: 9548 is a smudge, 9727 is a few hairline marks that nearly vanish against the black, and 9190 is a blank cell.
